text: 4.22 Standardisation of Adhoc Norms (a) For standardization of norms, an application in ANF 4B shall be filed online along with complete data. Such applications shall be made to concerned Norms Committee in DGFT headquarters. (b) Import of fuel may also be allowed with actual user condition under SION by Norms Committee subject to following: (i) Facility of import of fuel shall be allowed only to manufacturer having captive powerplant. (ii) In cases where SION specifically allows fuel, same shall be permitted under Advance Authorisation. However, if fuel is not covered specifically under SION, it may be allowed as per general fuel Policy for products covered under SION or under paragraph 4.07 above. (iii) Applications for fixation of fuel entitlement for new sectors and modification of the existing entitlement as per General Note for Fuel in Handbook of Procedures shall be filed online to the Norms Committee pg. 87 product(s) manufact | ured through | NI proce | ss.
